profile.headline: Software Engineer at Garmin within the Aviation Department

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Front-end development of the product software application using technologies such as
React and Three.js
• Assisted in improving the user experience of the software
• Researched technologies for development purposes
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Self-confidence · React.js · Active Learning · Three.js

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Aided in research for the Nebraska Center for Research on Children, Youth, Families and Schools to improve computer science education in elementary and secondary schools in Nebraska.
• Observed computer science teacher instructional strategies used in K-8 classrooms.
• Researched the effectiveness and impact of the program on teachers across Nebraska

positions.title: Housing Learning Communities Peer Mentor
positions.description:
• Aided in the development of social networks for first year students.
• Helped first year students explore areas of academic interest in the major(s) of the
learning community.
• Organized events for first year students to develop a community identity and
teamwork.

positions.title: C#/.NET Developer
positions.locationName: Green Bay, Wisconsin, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Programmed various dashboards for internal use using C#, DevExpress, and Bootstrap.
• Wrote SQL queries in Sequel Server Management Studio.
• Designed Jira boards to meet the needs of the team and organize tasks.
• Gained experience using Microsoft Project to manage a project.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Project · Bootstrap · Jira · SQL

positions.title: Senior Leader
positions.description:
• Managed staff in the Learning Assistant Program alongside the Program Coordinators.
• Optimized the experience of the Program for all its members.
• Organized training workshops, evaluate staff, and recruit members.

positions.title: Course Leader
positions.description:
• Coordinated with Instructors and Senior Leaders.
• Met with a group of Learning Assistants biweekly.
• Assisted students during office hours, labs, and hack sessions.
• Graded projects and assignments.

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description:
• The CSE Learning Assistant Program strives to improve student comprehension and retention in 
   computing fields by focusing on the learner’s experience.
• Assisted students during office hours, labs, and hack sessions.
• Facilitated communications between learners and instructors.
• Graded projects and assignments

positions.title: Phi Mu Ritual Chair
positions.description:
•	Organized ritual ceremonies (such as Pledging, Initiation, and 3D Ceremony) throughout the calendar year, as well as committee meetings
•	Led a committee in logistics for the ceremonies
•	Recorded ritual music and increased available resources for the chapter in regards to chapter rituals

positions.title: C#/.NET Developer
positions.locationName: Green Bay, Wisconsin, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Followed IT System and Business Analysts to gain understanding on their daily tasks
and responsibilities.
• Attended meetings to learn resource management, project planning, and problem solving.
• Enhanced C# programming language skills through coding maps to convert data from
one format to another.
• Involved in preparing cross reference information of business items for conversion
to a new system.

honors.title: Garmin ECE Scholarship
honors.description:
This award is given to three students annually who are majoring in computer science, computer engineering, or software engineering and have a great scholastic record.

Award years: Fall 2020 - Spring 2023
honors.issuer: Issued by UNL School of Computing · Aug 2020
